comments.text:
Jako ljepo
Baš raznolika i poštena zemlja.
Ne prevelika.
Gdje ljudi uglavnom žive svoje običaje i obiteljske i susjedske odnose.
Strikingly beautiful.
With a lot of diversity and honesty.
Not to large.
Where people are often  living their traditions and familiar and neighborhood relations .
